scripts.predev: docker compose up -d && npm run build --workspace backend
scripts.dev: tsx backend/src/cli/withAppEnv.ts --default development -- npm run dev --workspace frontend
scripts.predev:real: docker compose up -d && npm run build --workspace backend
scripts.dev:real: tsx backend/src/cli/withAppEnv.ts --set real -- npm run dev --workspace frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.db:create: tsx backend/src/cli/withAppEnv.ts --set development -- tsx backend/src/cli/dbAdmin.ts create
scripts.db:migrate: tsx backend/src/cli/withAppEnv.ts --default development -- npm run db:migrate --workspace backend
scripts.db:migrate:test: tsx backend/src/cli/withAppEnv.ts --set test -- npm run db:migrate --workspace backend
scripts.db:migrate:real: tsx backend/src/cli/withAppEnv.ts --set real -- npm run db:migrate:real --workspace backend
scripts.seed: tsx backend/src/cli/withAppEnv.ts --default development -- npm run seed --workspace backend
scripts._db:reset:dev: docker compose up -d --wait && tsx backend/src/cli/dbAdmin.ts reset ch_fuel_dev && npm run seed
scripts._db:reset:real: docker compose up -d --wait && tsx backend/src/cli/dbAdmin.ts reset ch_fuel_real && npm run seed && python scripts/load_gazetteer.py && npm run ingest -- data/bvd-prices/pcn-usd-9206810-981.csv && npm run backfill -- data/bvd-prices/2026-01/ && python scripts/resolve_from_operator.py && npm run resolve -- gazetteer && npm run import-invoice -- ./data/bvd-invoices/BVD_invoice_999210.pdf && npm run import-invoice -- ./data/bvd-invoices/BVD_invoice_999217.pdf
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace frontend && npm run lint --workspace backend
scripts.test: tsx backend/src/cli/withAppEnv.ts --set test -- npm run test --workspace backend && npm run test --workspace frontend
scripts.test:unit: tsx backend/src/cli/withAppEnv.ts --set test -- npm run test:unit --workspace backend && npm run test --workspace frontend
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
